d: Amy has a run in with an old friend that leads to heartache. Jack and Lisa prove they can be adventurous.
Lou’s forced to face the reason for her insomnia. Jack wins over a prickly dude ranch guest.
Amy helps a vaulting team ahead of a big competition. Caleb struggles with a tough decision about Carson.
Amy and Nathan retrain his horse. Jessica has to heal a rift with Jack.
An accident puts Shane’s wedding in jeopardy. Heartland Beef faces an uncertain future.
Amy returns from Europe and struggles to adjust to life at Heartland and her relationship with Ty.
After Jack makes a major announcement, Lou plans a party and forces Jack into an awkward reunion.
Amy’s attempts to reunite with Georgie are continually thwarted by the arrival of lavish gifts from afar.
A surprise visitor arrives at Heartland and makes a declaration that has serious consequences for Amy.
Amy struggles to turn a pair of horses into a team, and is forced to go head-to-head with a rival trainer.
When a client horse keeps escaping, Amy discovers the animal has unexpected abilities.
Amy struggles to help a Hutterite family whose team of Percherons ran amok during a hayride.
A school project opens a door to Georgie’s past that could ultimately change her life at Heartland.
Jack and Amy help an old friend when a herd of wild horses faces the threat of being destroyed.
With the fate of the wild horses hanging in the balance, Amy and Ty find themselves drawing closer.
Amy finds herself in a difficult position when a client reveals that Peter turned down a lucrative job offer.
When Amy is invited to do a horse clinic in Montana, she and Ty decide to take a road trip together.
Tim opens a rodeo school, determined to help young people avoid injury while getting the training they need.
Amy and Ty help Scott’s nephew realize he is worthy of continuing his family tradition of relay racing.
Lou returns from Vancouver with an admission that threatens to change the Heartland family forever.
The family strives to support a devastated Georgie when Lou and Peter are forced to tell her distressing news.
Lou spearheads preparations for the big day while Amy throws herself into gentling a rescue horse.
To give Amy and Ty the wedding they really want, Lou struggles to deal with a slew of last minute hurdles.
While a dangerous bear lurks near Heartland, Amy and Georgie rescue an injured horse from the woods.
Ty prepares to celebrate an important milestone as he and Amy treat an abandoned horse.
Georgie gets pulled away by Lou and Peter who insist she focus on her schoolwork.
Jack grapples with the impending loss of a loyal and trusted friend.
Georgie guilts Jack into helping her train on a new horse in the hopes he will fall in love with the animal.
Ty and Amy’s attempt to rescue an injured eagle in the mountains takes a dangerous turn.
Amy helps a Medieval jouster who was badly injured during a competition regain his confidence.
Amy’s attempts to help Georgie deal with an impending departure are complicated by Olivia.
Amy and Ty work together to determine why Caleb’s horse becomes ill during his treatment at Heartland.
Georgie begins to second-guess her decision to run away, while the family bands together to find her.
Ty gets roped into helping Jack and Tim on a cattle drive but an unforeseen accident jeopardizes their plans.
Tim seeks Amy and Georgie’s help to discourage Jade from accepting a shady sponsorship deal.
Amy and Cass work together to save a racehorse with a career-ending condition.
Georgie’s school project on Val Stanton inspires her to take a risk with Adam.
When Lou returns from New York there's a new ranch hand and food truck that is threatening Maggie’s business.
Lou finds herself trapped at the Dude Ranch with Mitch, the new ranch hand.
While helping Cass handle a spirited horse, Amy learns there is more riding on their success than she realized.
When their plans to get away are thwarted, Amy and Ty celebrate their first anniversary closer to home.
As Amy and Ty prepare for parenthood, they work together to resolve a dangerous pregnancy issue.
Ty performs life-saving surgery on a mare, while the family works around-the-clock to bottle feed the foals.
Tim is caught in the middle of Jade’s showdown with a new hotshot bronc rider.
When Amy and Ty reach a difficult decision, the family grapples with the implications of their choice.
When one of Tim’s team-building events turns competitive, Georgie gets stuck partnering with Jade’s rival.
When Amy helps an archer reconnect with her horse, she unravels the mystery behind Spartan’s recent behavior.
When Lou is given a horse, Amy helps her sister nurture a connection with the animal.
Fearing the worst, Jack is shocked to learn the reason for an old friend’s unexpected visit to Heartland.
An out-of-town horse clinic takes a dangerous turn for Amy, Tim and Georgie.
While Amy deals with a panicked horse trapped in a trailer, Georgie heads off on a desperate search for Tim.
When Georgie unexpectedly struggles with a new challenge, Amy steps in to help her unearth the cause.
After tragedy strikes, Amy and Georgie work together to help Tim’s traumatized barrel-racing horse.
When an unexpected guest arrives at Heartland, Amy and Jack question the real reason for the surprise visit.
Mallory is forced to admit to Amy and Jack the real reason she came back to Heartland.
Amy struggles with the feeling that something is not right with Ty while striving to help the ghost horse.
A secret from Jack’s past threatens to change his relationship with the family forever.
Amy and the family pull together as the gravely ill Ty returns home and is admitted to hospital.
Amy, Ty and the entire Heartland family are thrilled to welcome a new member into the fold.
Ty struggles with control issues when his mom stops by for an unexpected visit to bond with her granddaughter.
The family bands together to support Georgie as she decides whether to face a ghost from her past.
Tim steps up Jade’s training regimen when a fierce new competitor shows her up at practice.
Amy and Ty work together to prepare a wild horse for overseas transport.
Lou returns from New York, only to find that things are not running as smoothly as she had imagined they would.
Amy has to get creative when asked to work with Lisa’s racehorse.
Amy tries to teach some old friends about the life-changing power of connecting to a horse.
When Tim’s erratic behavior sparks concern from his loved ones, Jack suspects something else is going on.
Amy tries to get everything at Heartland organized before joining Ty on a work-related journey.
Ty finds himself in a dangerous situation. Amy must turn to an unexpected source for guidance.
Tim is forced to open up when an emergency traps him with an unexpected visitor.
Struggling with personal issues, Tim rallies the family to go on another memorial ride for Marion.
As the family struggles to deal with Tim’s news, Lou throws herself into planning her high school reunion.
A threat from Ty’s past arrives in Hudson, putting the entire Heartland family in danger.
As Thanksgiving approaches, Georgie convinces Amy to work with a high strung and dangerous jumping horse.
A training accident results in a serious injury and Georgie feels conflicted when an unlikely ally arrives.
In the aftermath of a vicious viral video, Georgie reconsiders her future in show jumping… and in Hudson.
The Heartland family members find themselves keeping secrets from each other.
Amy and Ty face parenting problems, but healing a wild mare and her foal may help them find the solution.
Amy and Ty plan a romantic trip to Pike River, but Jack tags along to visit an old friend.
Ty is asked to mentor a troubled kid, but finding common ground proves harder than he expected.
Amy and Ty take Lyndy on her first camping trip, but things go awry when they find an injured animal.
Georgie enlists Wyatt’s help in reuniting a famous trick rider with her long-lost horse.
The new manager at Fairfield comes to Amy and Ty with an unusual concern.
Amy and Tim organize a team penning event for the family, but Tim manages to turn it into a town spectacle.
Lou returns to Heartland with an unconventional idea to attract guests to the Dude Ranch.
Amy and Ty work together to treat a doped racehorse.
After receiving tragic news, the family finds ways to cope with their grief.
When Jack finds out Will Vernon’s wild horses are in danger, the family rallies behind him to bring them home.
A disgruntled horse owner causes problems for Ty and Amy’s business.
Amy is hired to gentle one of the wild horses, but his temperament may prove impossible to work with.
Jack is faced with painful memories from his past, and the family is at a loss for how to help him.
A dangerous windstorm wreaks havoc on Hudson.
Amy and Ty worry about the impact a surprise visitor will have on Luke.
Georgie’s graduation has finally arrived, but so has a mysterious figure from her past.
Amy is asked to spend time at an art retreat to work with an artist’s allegedly traumatized horse.
Tim is roped into organizing an important rodeo when an old flame blows back into Hudson asking for his help.
Amy and Ty get some unexpected news about Luke just as Amy has to face an upsetting truth about Spartan.
When fears of holding on or letting go grip the family, they look to each other for support.
While Amy deals with a major upheaval in her life, Lou copes with the reality of being the mayor of Hudson.
Amy's efforts to help a young girl form a connection with her new horse takes an unexpected turn.
Lou gets into even more hot water when she tries to sell Hudson as a “must see” tourist destination.
Disaster strikes Hudson when a train derails and causes an explosion that threatens the surrounding area.
The black stallion that Amy rehomed from Will’s ranch is brutally forced out of the herd by the new leader.
When a group of wild horses need new homes, Amy must host her first horse clinic in over a year.
Tim seeks out help from an unlikely person when he finds himself competing in a polo match.
After another Miracle Girl moment, Amy reconsiders her role at the Youth Centre. Jack misses Lisa.
Amy’s decision to work with Peyton Westfield’s horse upsets Logan. Lou has to come through for Rick.
Amy and Caleb train one of Sam’s rescue horses to be a roping horse. Jack and Tim disagree about Blue’s future.
Amy’s surprised to learn Finn has returned to town. Jack and Tim win Hudson’s Entrepreneur of the Year Award.
When flood evacuees come to Hudson, Amy works with a traumatized horse. Jack and Lisa help a young couple.
Amy helps a unique animal from an abandoned zoo. Jack and Lisa work through difficulties in their relationship.
A storm leads to a sad goodbye and the return of old friends. Lou reads Katie’s journal without permission.
Amy teaches Lyndy how to barrel race. Logan’s father arrives at Heartland. Katie gets her ears pierced.
Amy leads a trail ride to help with Jessica’s new photography job. Lou’s latest mayoral event upsets Rick.
